reported_results.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum

claims.finding: Video reports percentages attributed to an external award poll. The report order is not a descending ordering of the listed percentages.
limitations: Headline total cannot be used as every fragrance's denominator
Unique women and voting eligibility not independently established
Approval percentage definition, net-vote mechanics and sampling not verified
Concentration and year of some products need resolution
Commercial guide and AI recommendation product appear in the source context
next_evidence_needed: Per-item raw denominators and approval definition

claims.finding: Original category/article identified for follow-up. No raw results or voter demographics were collected from these pages.
limitations: A category title does not establish voter gender
Indexed or creator-reported results do not replace the original denominator
Vote weighting may differ from a simple participant proportion

claims.finding: The article describes unbranded atomizers and initial plus later assessment; Jimmy Choo Man Extreme was its reported female favorite within the tested selection.
limitations: Female subgroup denominator and raw ballots unavailable in inspected material
Overall article score weights male feedback more; it is not a female-only score
Small selected product set cannot establish a universal top fragrance
Publication/testing/last-checked dates appear inconsistent and need clarification

Full item-level review remains incomplete
